name: Chichu Art Museum (Benesse Art Site Naoshima)
intro: An art museum on the island of Naoshima, built mostly underground, where a few works are shown in natural light. Entry is by timed ticket only, and a whole month goes on sale at once.

facts.bookAhead: Two months: tickets go on sale on the 5th, for the month after next

statusNote: Read from the official Benesse Art Site Naoshima FAQ.
howToBuy: Buy timed-entry tickets on the official Benesse Art Site Naoshima website. Entry is in 30-minute slots.
A whole month goes on sale at 10:00 Japan time on the 5th, two months ahead. For example, October tickets go on sale on August 5.
Online payment is by credit card only (Visa, Mastercard or JCB).
rulesToKnow: Naoshima is reached by ferry, so check ferry times before choosing an entry slot.

soldOut.label: Naoshima art island tours on Klook

faq.q: When do Chichu Art Museum tickets go on sale?
faq.a: At 10:00 Japan time on the 5th of each month, for the month after next. For example, tickets for October go on sale on August 5.

faq.q: How do I pay for Chichu Art Museum tickets?
faq.a: By credit card online: Visa, Mastercard or JCB.

sources.quote: We start selling online tickets for the month after next at 10:00 on the 5th of every month.
Ticket sales for October start at 10:00 on August 5th
